OVERVIEW

Sham Marianas brand-guideline project was created to forge a consistent and impactful visual identity that embodies the agency’s creative and forward-thinking presence. It articulates key brand components such as the primary and alternate logos, colour palette, typography system and application rules to ensure brand cohesion. The guideline spans across both physical and digital platforms, including stationery, signage, internal workspace graphics and social-media visuals, enabling the agency to present a unified, professional image at every touch-point.
